content: Veeam Agent for Windows (official helpcenter): 'The following file system objects' tree with checkboxes; checking a folder auto-includes subfolders, excluding by unchecking child checkboxes. Checking a whole volume shows a volume-level mark; unchecking any folder downgrades it to a file-level mark enabling filters. Include/exclude masks (wildcards) via Advanced dialog; exclude masks outrank include masks; selecting an entire volume disables file-type filters (folder-level exclusions only). Always-excluded list: temp folder, Recycle Bin, pagefile, hibernate file, VSS snapshot files, EFS-encrypted files. Caveats: no exclusions from mount points; excluding folders on deduplicated volumes may corrupt backup.
